page_title: BET 1-0 PAL | Betis v Las Palmas 09/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+5' Betis win a corner.

90+5' Isco (Betis) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the bottom right corner. His effort isn't powerful enough, though, allowing Jasper Cillessen to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
90+5' Isco (Betis) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

90+3' Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jose Sanchez no option but to blow his whistle. PENALTY! One of the players from Betis is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
90+2' Isco (Betis) steps up to send the ball in.
90+1' Booking. Juanma Herzog (Las Palmas) receives a caution from the referee.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' It will be a substitution. Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) is ready to enter the pitch as Alex Suarez walks off.
88' The foul by Cedric Bakambu (Betis) was seen by Jose Sanchez who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Las Palmas have been awarded a free kick.
87' Isco (Betis) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
84' Substitution. Jose Campana did his best and is replaced by Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas).
82' Isco (Betis) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
81' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Jasper Cillessen is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
80' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. Mateo Flores (Betis) replaces Johnny Cardoso.
80' The referee Jose Sanchez awards Johnny Cardoso (Betis) a yellow card.
78' The ball is out of play. Las Palmas will have a throw-in.
76' Substitution. Cedric Bakambu (Betis) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Cucho Hernandez walks off.
76' The attendance for today's match is 49292.
76' A snap shot from distance by Isco (Betis) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
73' Diego Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) replacing Sandro Ramirez.

73' Sergi Altimira (Betis) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Jasper Cillessen!
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marvin (Las Palmas) replaces Viti.
72' Isco (Betis) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
68' Isco (Betis) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
67' The ball is behind the touchline and Betis will take a throw-in.
67' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) is given a yellow card.

65' 1 - 0 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Diego Llorente (Betis) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the right side of the net.
65' A dangerous looking corner kick from Isco (Betis) is cleared to safety by the defence.
63' Isco (Betis) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Las Palmas get a free kick.
62' Here is a change. Jesus Rodriguez is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis).
62' The referee allows time for a substitution. Pablo Fornals will be replaced by Sergi Altimira (Betis).
62' Although Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) is just on the bench, Jose Sanchez has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
61' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) picks up his second yellow card from referee Jose Sanchez and is given his marching orders.

59' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
58' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick to Las Palmas.
55' Viti (Las Palmas) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Adrian easily deals with the threat.
53' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) was quite harsh and Jose Sanchez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
52' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) tries to catch the keeper off guard from long range, but the effort sails well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
51' Rough tackle by Alex Munoz (Las Palmas). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Betis win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
50' Antony (Betis) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
49' The ball is out of play. Betis will take a throw-in.
47' Las Palmas failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

46' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The linesman makes the right call and Las Palmas will have a corner.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Jose Sanchez has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' What a beautiful long-range strike by Alex Munoz (Las Palmas). He is quite unlucky as his shot flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
44' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Jasper Cillessen is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
43' The linesman signals a throw-in for Las Palmas.
42' Isco (Betis) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

42' Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis) receives a nice pass from the free kick and strikes from the edge of the box, but his attempt hits one of the defenders and bounces away off him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Betis.
41' Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
39' Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Sanchez had an easy-decision to make.
38' Alex Munoz (Las Palmas) picks up a yellow card.
38' Betis keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
37' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 3:2.
36' The ball has crossed the sideline. Betis are taking a throw-in.
33' The ball is out of play. Las Palmas will have a throw-in.
30' Viti (Las Palmas) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
30' It's a throw-in for Betis.
28' Isco (Betis) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
27' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle and it's Jose Campana (Las Palmas) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Betis will take a free kick near the side line.

26' Pablo Fornals (Betis) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the left post! The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
26' 64:36 – the ratio of ball possession.
25' Las Palmas are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
21' Alex Munoz (Las Palmas) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
21' Juanma Herzog (Las Palmas) connects well with the free kick, but heads the ball just over the bar from close in. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
20' Alex Munoz (Las Palmas) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
19' Diego Llorente (Betis) picks up a yellow card.
19' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Betis.
18' Pablo Fornals (Betis) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
16' Antony (Betis) prepares to take a corner kick.
15' Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Sanchez saw the whole situation. A free kick has been awarded to Las Palmas.
14' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
13' The ball is behind the touchline and Betis will take a throw-in.
11' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for an infringement. Las Palmas are awarded the free kick.
9' Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Betis.
8' Isco (Betis) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
6' The ball is out of play. Betis will take a throw-in.
5' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but sends his shot slightly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
3' The corner kick from Isco (Betis) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

3' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

1' Jose Sanchez interrupts the game. One of the players from Las Palmas won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. It's a free kick to Betis, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
1' The linesman signals a throw-in for Betis.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Betis will have the kick-off.
Jose Sanchez was nominated as the referee for this game.
